description: A governed folder of files in the object store with an owner group and grants.

spec.description: A governed folder of files in the object store with an owner group and grants.

catalog.description: The catalog (Lakehouse) this volume belongs to; the owner group is inherited.

items.description: One group's rights on a volume. Subjects are groups, never users.

group.description: The Keycloak group whose members hold these verbs.

verbs.description: At least one verb; each verb at most once.

items.description:
What a grant lets a group do: `read` a file or list a folder, `write` upload, change or
delete one, `manage` change the grants and delete the volume.

purpose.description:
What a volume holds. A `libraries` volume is code that every reader executes, so it
restricts `write` to groups that also manage it (decision D28, internal note
`design/volumes.md` §5).

storage.description:
Where a volume's files live: exactly one of platform-managed storage or an external
prefix. Files live in the volume bucket, never in the table bucket (D28).

external.description: A prefix in the customer's own bucket, reached through an `s3` connection.

connection.description: Name of the `s3` connection that holds the endpoint, bucket and credentials.

prefix.description: Key prefix inside the bucket; absent means the prefix the connection already scopes.

managed.description:
Storage the platform owns: the volume gets `volumes/<catalog>/<name>/` in the platform
object store. `managed: {}` selects it.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: storage must be either managed or external, not both and not neither
an external prefix must not contain .. or //
each group may appear once in grants
a verb may appear once per grant
on a libraries volume only a group that also manages it may write
x-kubernetes-validations.rule: self.purpose != 'libraries' || self.grants.all(g, !('write' in g.verbs) || ('manage' in g.verbs))

prefix.description: The object-store prefix the volume maps to.

ready.description: True when the prefix exists and its grants apply; filled by a later controller.

title: Volume
